name: predictive-debugger
description: Predicts where code is likely to fail. Ships as a VS Code extension and as an MCP server that coding agents can call while reviewing code. Auth is borrowed from the Claude Code, Codex, or GitHub Copilot CLI you are already signed in to.
author: SpeedosDK

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run bundle
scripts.bench: node bench/generate-corpus.mjs && node bench/measure.mjs && node bench/measure-file.mjs && node bench/markdown.mjs

commands.title: Predictive Debugger: Predict Failures in Current File
Predictive Debugger: Predict Failures Across Project

predictiveDebugger.claudeModel.description: Model alias passed to the Claude Code CLI (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5). Leave empty to use the CLI's own default.

predictiveDebugger.codexModel.description: Model passed to the Codex CLI. Leave empty to use the CLI's own default.

predictiveDebugger.copilotModel.description: Model passed to the GitHub Copilot CLI (e.g. gpt-5.4, or auto to let Copilot pick). Leave empty to use the CLI's own default.

predictiveDebugger.logFile.description: Workspace-relative path to a log file to analyse alongside the source. Leave empty to skip log analysis.

predictiveDebugger.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used for the log analyzer. Leave empty to auto-detect. This is a machine-scoped setting: a workspace cannot override it, because the value is executed.

predictiveDebugger.multipleFindings.description: Ask the model for every runtime failure it can demonstrate in a file, ranked, instead of the single most likely one. Experimental: the confidence gate that decides what reaches the Problems panel was measured on single-verdict replies.

predictiveDebugger.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to analyse in a project run. Each file costs one CLI call.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Predictive Debugger spawns the Claude Code, Codex, or GitHub Copilot CLI and reads workspace-configured paths, so it requires a trusted workspace.
